description: This file extends the FileHandle class with safe read methods that utilize Swift's error handling to avoid exceptions caused by legacy APIs, providing safer mechanisms for reading data until EOF or up to a specified byte count.

classes.name: FileHandle
classes.description: An extension of the FileHandle class adding safe reading methods.

methods.name: readToEndSafely
methods.description: Reads data until the end of file safely, returning empty Data on failure.

methods.name: readSafely(upToCount:)
methods.description: Reads up to a specified number of bytes safely, returning empty Data on failure or EOF.
